# Servlead Solutions

> AI automation and efficiency consulting for owner-run businesses in the Lehigh Valley, PA (Allentown, Bethlehem, Easton, and surrounding). Founder Sam Gorla does the work himself. Your business runs through your head. I help you fix that.

## Who it's for
- Owner-run Lehigh Valley businesses in three groups: contractors and trades; professional services (CPAs, law firms, insurance agencies, agencies); and healthcare practices (dental, PT, chiropractic, counseling), limited to scheduling, intake, and billing follow-up, never clinical or patient records.

## What it costs
- Free 30-minute look: a free 30-minute look at one or two workflows. Phone, Teams, or in person in the Lehigh Valley. This is not an audit. Book: https://cal.com/samgorla/quick-connect
- The AI & Efficiency Audit: $1,000. $500 to book, $500 when the written plan lands (within 48 hours). If I don't show you at least $10,000 a year leaking out of your business, audit is free. Book: https://cal.com/samgorla/consultation
- Bigger operation, $10M and up? I'll scope the audit to the right department, or the whole company, on the 30-minute call.
